mandate: C426 — test the price-only WLMF: wavelet leader multifractal spectrum (spectrum width Δh = h_max − h_min at D(h) ≥ 0, and spectrum centroid h* = argmax D(h) via the wavelet leader Legendre transform) stat-arb family on 10 USDT-M linear perps at native 5m (1296 pre-registered configs). Per-bar primitives: perp_close real 5m kline close; log_return=log(c[t]/c[t-1]) (r[0]=0); abs_ret=|log_return|. Over fixed intrinsic window W=256 trailing closes C=c_i[t-W+1..t] (log-prices L=log(C)): decimated periodic DWT (db3), J=5 levels, scale 2^j, per-level 2^{-j/2} norm; wavelet leader L_j[k]=max_{j'<=j, k' in cyclic[(k-1)*2^{j-j'}..(k+2)*2^{j-j'}-1]}|d_{j'}[k']| (3λ box); structure function S(q,j)=mean_k L_j[k]^q (q in [-5,5], 21 moments); scaling exponent ζ(q)=slope of log2 S(q,j) vs j over levels {2,3,4,5}; Legendre spectrum D(h)=q*h-ζ(q)+1 (h=dζ/dq); wlmf_width=Δh=h_max-h_min over {q:D(h)>=0}; wlmf_centroid=h* at argmax_q D(h). NaN if t<W-1 or any NaN/non-finite in C[t-W+1..t], no valid spectrum, or not finite. Seasonal baseline = trailing mean/std at same (weekday,tod) bucket from history strictly before bar t (causal shift(1)), NaN-aware, excluding NaN obs. Signals: 4 real+placebo (wlmf_width_dev, wlmf_centroid_dev) + 2 placebos (phase-randomized surrogates, never edges). Single-leg dollar-neutral perp PnL with costs on turnover (taker=fee+slip; maker_blend=0.5*fee+slip). Gates: Holm+BH at alpha=0.05 (BOTH), MDE, stability, signal-vs-placebo attribution. PRE-REGISTERED NaN policy: metric NaN unless sufficient finite obs; seasonal stats NaN-aware min_periods excluding NaN obs; NaN-score bars weight 0.

data_quality.note: metric NaN share dominated by finite-obs requirements (t<W=256 or NaN in trailing W+1-bar close window).

methodology.raw_features: perp_close real 5m kline close from C312 (strictly positive, gap-free); log_return=log(c[t]/c[t-1]) (r[0]=0); abs_ret=|log_return|.
methodology.primitives: fixed intrinsic window W=256 trailing closes C=c_i[t-W+1..t] (log-prices L=log(C)); decimated periodic db3 DWT, J=5 levels, scale 2^j, per-level 2^{-j/2} norm; detail d_j; wavelet leader L_j[k]=max_{j'<=j, k' in cyclic[(k-1)*2^{j-j'}..(k+2)*2^{j-j'}-1]}|d_{j'}[k']| (3lambda box); structure function S(q,j)=mean_k L_j[k]^q (q in [-5,5], 21 moments); scaling exponent zeta(q)=slope of log2 S(q,j) vs j over levels {2,3,4,5}; Legendre spectrum D(h)=q*h-zeta(q)+1 (h=dzeta/dq); wlmf_width=Delta h=h_max-h_min over {q:D(h)>=0}; wlmf_centroid=h* at argmax_q D(h).
methodology.signals: wlmf_width_dev/wlmf_centroid_dev plus phase-randomized-surrogate placebos over fixed W=256; score=-(v-m)/sd with m/sd trailing same-bucket mean/std (min_periods=3, excluding NaN, causal shift(1)); cross-sectional rank, dollar-neutral gross 1.0; NaN-score assets weight 0.
methodology.pnl: single-leg perp: pnl = sum_i pos_i * perp_ret_i.
methodology.costs: charged on turnover; taker = fee+slip; maker_blend = 0.5*fee+slip.
methodology.missing_data: non-finite -> NaN; never impute/ffill; insufficient valid obs -> NaN -> not traded (fail-closed).
methodology.multiple_testing: one-sided paired t-test of per-split OOS net vs 0; Holm step-down AND Benjamini-Hochberg over all 1296 configs at alpha=0.05.
methodology.attribution: mean |OOS net| per signal across all its configs; shares=|mean|/sum(|means|) over all 4 signals incl. placebos; dominant must be a real (non-placebo) signal with share >= 0.5 for attribution_ok.
methodology.stability: sign consistency >= 0.70 of splits AND first/second-half Sharpe corr >= 0.5.
methodology.placebo: phase-randomized surrogate via FFT phase randomization + rank restoration to original marginal; deterministic seed recorded; same marginal distribution, destroyed temporal alignment.
methodology.wlmf_vectorization_note: close matrix C=(T,10) built once; per asset, log-price series L[j]=log(c[j]); per window ending at t, trailing W=256 log-prices L[t-W+1..t]; decimated periodic db3 DWT (J=5) vectorized per chunk of windows; wavelet leaders via 3lambda box max over finer scales; structure function over 21 q moments; zeta(q) slope over levels {2,3,4,5}; Legendre spectrum D(h); width=Delta h and centroid=h* per window; validated against brute-force per-window loop with explicit gather+matvec DWT + explicit leader index sets + multifractal spectrum, maxdiff < 1e-12 in tests.
